tests.goal: same XiaoYu identity across restart
same XiaoYu identity across model/provider swap
desktop and QQ share one continuing identity
N.E.K.O native runtime_auto_start plugins restore after product restart without enabling the Agent master
tests.note: N.E.K.O native runtime_auto_start remains the lifecycle authority. The overlay recovery helper only restores persisted autostart state through native lifecycle APIs and the independent User Plugin relay through the native Agent flags API; it does not enable Agent analyzer/computer/browser.

tests.goal: owner-private memory does not leak into group context
private context cannot silently drift to a privacy-ineligible provider without an explicit owner reconfiguration
tests.note: Manual provider edits are explicit owner configuration operations. Existing sessions keep their captured provider/client and are retired by identity before configuration reload; normal XiaoYu startup reruns the allowlist preflight.

tests.goal: owner correction stops obsolete facts/persona from being current
scoped forget clears active/archive/cold/index/derived state
old restore cannot revive erased material
in-flight extraction cannot write erased material back
commitments survive restart without duplicate proactive delivery
tests.note: Acceptance goal is restart continuity plus exactly-once proactive delivery. Native N.E.K.O cue/delivery already proves this; a separate XiaoYu commitment UI would duplicate the mother project without adding required behavior.

tests.goal: ambiguous non-idempotent effects are not blindly retried
tests.note: N.E.K.O distinguishes definitely-not-delivered from may-have-arrived and never blindly redispatches the uncertain case.

tests.goal: native realtime PCM reaches Qwen3.8 speech detection, transcription and assistant response
XiaoYu desktop avatar resolves through N.E.K.O native Live3D/VRM configuration and serves the bound VRM asset
tests.note: Uses N.E.K.O native character/model configuration only; no XiaoYu renderer or core patch is introduced.

tests.goal: desktop + voice/vision + QQ + tools work under one XiaoYu identity
tests.note: Physical microphone acceptance passed on a user-attested live utterance after Qwen3.8 realtime VAD fallback; verifier persisted only structural markers and lengths.

tests.goal: legacy canonical XiaoYu persona can be staged deterministically into N.E.K.O without importing bootstrap/test memories or widening scope
the current upstream N.E.K.O mother-project pin can replace the prior pin while preserving XiaoYu acceptance and deterministic managed-patch replay
tests.note: The 6261a5f6 upgrade established deterministic replay for the original five patches. Later evidence-backed patches add speech-output gating and a generic provider-native first-round tool-choice bridge; all managed patches remain authority-checked by startup preflight.

tests.goal: explicit natural-language interaction controls become deterministic proactive, audible-speech, and autonomous-screen hard state while preserving N.E.K.O native authorities
tests.note: Proactive execution remains N.E.K.O proactive_controller; screen privacy is written through the native user conversation-settings CAS route; audible output uses the sixth managed N.E.K.O boundary patch. Private plugin 0.5.0 is live; the hard-control state survived the cutover, while retrospective activity now delegates to ActivityWatch instead of a private timeline.

tests.goal: recent owner-computer activity can be recalled from bounded local evidence without inventing inactivity or storing raw window titles/screenshots
tests.note: ActivityWatch 0.14.3 is the retrospective desktop-activity authority. XiaoYu is a read-only query adapter and returns app/duration/coverage only; ActivityWatch window-title collection is disabled. Provider-native qwen3.8 forced tool_choice with reasoning_effort=none handles the previously failing negative wording; later rounds restore normal reasoning.

tests.goal: XiaoYu can switch between the preferred Qwen clone and the existing CosyVoice clone while reusing one character voice store/picker and the native Qwen realtime transport
tests.note: The retired legacy qwen3-tts-vc model is not revived. The existing reference audio was re-enrolled into current Qwen3.8 Omni realtime and Qwen-Audio 3.1 TTS clones. One qwen_bundle picker entry routes by surface; CosyVoice remains selectable.
